author: Jo Anne Fleming
text: So are you saying your sugars go below 1.8?  The reader has a point which it cannot register sugars and will just read a low sugar alert.  Just as it does high sugars over 24.  If your sugars fall below 3.8, you need to eat sugar or drink juice, whatever your protocol is for you.  This is a very dangerous condition and could kill you or damage your brain.  You really need to see a doctor if this is happening on a regular basis.
